watch.summary: A streamer intensely watches a Valorant esports match, screaming in disbelief as his team loses a 3v1 clutch.

beats.what: Streamer cheers hype as his team makes a kill.
Streamer yells in excitement, encouraging his team.
The round turns into a 1v3 and streamer gets nervous.
Streamer begs his team to swarm the lone opponent.
Streamer screams in agony, hands on head, asking why they gave away the 1v3.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Why are we giving him a 1v3?!
watch.why: The comedy stems from the dramatic contrast between the streamer's initial high-energy excitement and his utter agony when his team chokes a 3v1 round. His animated body language and passionate screaming make the breakdown entertaining to watch.
